title: It Falls On Anyone
payload:
[Theme: I asked for the line to be drawn in the open, it was drawn exactly right, and it came down over my head]
[SONG FORM: THE CHECK — Claim / V / C / V / C / The Count / C / V / C / V / The Cost / C with one word changed / instrumental close]
[Disc_Rhythm: retractable pen clicked twice a bar from bar one | tight field snare, sticks audible | dry kit pushing ahead | the pen never pushes]
[Disc_Vocal: adult contralto | close | plain | no melisma | no lift | absent for the final stretch]
[Disc_Sub: warm round sub | one note per bar | no slides | no drop]
[Disc_Pad: dry hall, medium | no choir | no swell]
[Disc_Texture: plucked ostinato repeating without variation | distant eight-bit arpeggio | muted string figure]

[The Claim - EMO:Resolve/Dignity - Contralto alone, plain - pen twice a bar, one sub note]
Here is what would count as winning.
Say it now so it can be checked later.
The line falls where it falls,
and it falls on anyone.
That is the whole of what I asked for.

[Verse 1 - EMO:Dignity/Determination - Contralto close - plucked ostinato enters, snare on the four]
I asked for the line.
I asked for it in the open.
I asked for it before I knew where I stood.
That is the only time it is worth asking.
Anybody can ask for a line
once the line already lies underneath.
I asked when I did not know.
So I get what I get.

[Chorus 1 - EMO:Determination/Dignity - Contralto plain, no lift - full kit, nothing added]
Draw it where anybody can stand and see it.
Draw it in the light and leave it.
The line falls where it falls,
and it falls on anyone.
Check it.
Check the whole count.
Check it on me.

[Verse 2 - EMO:Vigilance/Resolve - Contralto flat - sub steps, string figure muted]
It got drawn on a Tuesday.
It got drawn the way I said.
Somebody stood and read the numbers out.
Somebody stood and read the numbers again.
Nothing was moved. Nothing was skipped.
The count came out the way the count comes out.
There is no story in it.
That is what it is for.

[Chorus 2 - EMO:Determination/Dignity - Contralto plain - full kit, flat]
Draw it where anybody can stand and see it.
Draw it in the light and leave it.
The line falls where it falls,
and it falls on anyone.
Check it.
Check the whole count.
Check it on me.

[The Count - EMO:Indignation/Dignity - Contralto singular and close - kit thins to snare and pen]
The line came down at nine and dropped me under it.
Everything at nine and over stays.
I came in at eight.
Eight is not nine.
Nobody moved it. Nobody nudged it.
Nobody made a mistake.
That is the part there is no argument with.
Nobody made a mistake.
And it is over my head.

[Chorus 3 - EMO:Dignity/Resolve - Contralto plain - full band returns, nothing added]
Draw it where anybody can stand and see it.
Draw it in the light and leave it.
The line falls where it falls,
and it falls on anyone.
Check it.
Check the whole count.
Check it on me.

[Verse 3 - EMO:Resolve/Dignity - Contralto low and even - ostinato alone under the first four]
I would draw it again.
I would draw it in the same place.
I would draw it before I knew.
I would put the chalk in a stranger's hand
and turn around while it got drawn.
That is not me being good.
That is the only version that holds
when it comes down on my side of it.

[Chorus 4 - EMO:Determination/Dignity - Contralto plain - full kit, flat, no lift]
Draw it where anybody can stand and see it.
Draw it in the light and leave it.
The line falls where it falls,
and it falls on anyone.
Check it.
Check the whole count.
Check it on me.

[Verse 4 - EMO:Moral Outrage/Dignity - Contralto close and dry - snare doubles, pen unchanged]
Somebody could have moved it for me.
Somebody had the chalk and the reason.
Nobody moved it.
That is the good news.
That is also the whole of the bad news.
The same nobody both times.
A line that bends for one
is a line that lets anybody lean.

[The Cost - EMO:Dignity/Disappointment - Contralto plain, quiet, no decoration - band unchanged]
Here is what it moved.
The place goes to somebody standing at nine.
The date I had down after it
does not have an after now.
I took my name off the list myself.
Nobody had to take it off.
It is not carrying. It is subtraction.
Put it in the column, mark it, move on.

[Chorus 5, one word changed - EMO:Dignity/Moral Outrage - Contralto singular and close - the pen stops here for good, band completes]
*a pen clicks and does not click again*
Draw it where anybody can stand and see it.
Draw it in the light and leave it.
The line falls where it falls,
and it falls on me.
Check it.
Check the whole count.
Check it on me.

[Spoken - EMO:Dignity - Contralto, spoken once, conversational - no lift, no reverb]
It falls on me.

[The form completes - EMO:Dignity/Resolve - no vocal - every promise kept, cadence lands on the one, out]

title: The Car Park Should Hear This

[Theme: a function room, a fire door on a closer, and a woman who has decided an empty car park is entitled to hear the good bit, for no reason at all]
[SONG FORM: No-Job Form - Outside/Chorus/V1/Chorus/Door One/V2/Chorus/Door Two/V3/Chorus/Good Bit/Chorus/Shut; chorus byte-identical x5, verses shorten 10-8-6, nothing gets bigger]

[Outside - EMO:Anticipation - alto distant - two seconds of car park, one thing]
Out here it's just a bin lid.
In there it's already going.

[Chorus - EMO:Glee+Silliness - alto chest, room-singable - byte-identical, full size]
The car park should hear this.
The car park should hear this.

and the car park should hear this.
That door's staying open.
That door's staying open.
Boot in the gap, hand on the bar,
and the car park should hear this.

[Verse 1 - EMO:Amusement - alto forward - ten short lines, a door doing its job]
Function room, low ceiling, brown carpet.
Fire door at the back on a closer.
Push it open, count to seven,
and the closer takes it off you.
It is not being difficult.
It is a door doing its job.
Seven seconds and a boot,
that's the whole of my equipment.
There is nobody in the car park.
That is not the point.

[Chorus - EMO:Glee+Silliness - alto chest - byte-identical, nothing added]
The car park should hear this.
The car park should hear this.
Bins and a hatchback and a puddle
and the car park should hear this.
That door's staying open.
That door's staying open.
Boot in the gap, hand on the bar,
and the car park should hear this.

[Door One - EMO:Mirth - alto moving, off-mic - the closer doing its worst]
Hiss. Thump. Shut again.
Hiss. Thump. Shut again.
I'm going back for it.
Keep going, I can hear you.
Hiss. Thump. Sh—
Got it. Boot's in.

*short laugh, not retaken*

[Verse 2 - EMO:Silliness - alto further off, uncompensated - eight short lines]
I've got one boot in a door
and one sock on a car park.
I'm doing the second chorus
from further off than a singer should.
Nobody move it. Nobody helpful.
The last helpful person shut it.
Ha — no, the last one shut it,
and I had to walk all the way back.

[Chorus - EMO:Glee+Silliness - alto distant, unfixed - byte-identical, same size]
The car park should hear this.
The car park should hear this.
Bins and a hatchback and a puddle
and the car park should hear this.
That door's staying open.
That door's staying open.
Boot in the gap, hand on the bar,
and the car park should hear this.

[Door Two - EMO:Wonder - alto close - bar 53, the crate, the top opens]
Milk crate. Under it. Done.
Hiss has stopped. Door's staying.
Nothing else has changed at all.
Same speed. Same size. More sky.
Out it goes across the tarmac
and hits the wall of the flats.

[Verse 3 - EMO:Glee - alto delighted - six short lines, a fox and a lit window]
A fox has looked at me.
The fox has gone. Fair enough.
There's a light on in one flat
and it did not go off.
I'm taking that as a yes.
It isn't one. I'm taking it.

[Chorus - EMO:Glee+Silliness - alto chest - byte-identical, top open]
The car park should hear this.
The car park should hear this.
Bins and a hatchback and a puddle
and the car park should hear this.
That door's staying open.
That door's staying open.
Boot in the gap, hand on the bar,
and the car park should hear this.

[The Good Bit - EMO:Amusement - alto through a door - she is outside for it]
Inside they've hit the bit —
the one where the hole is,
where the third note doesn't come
and everybody leans in.
I'm out here with a crate.
I can hear it through a door.

[Chorus - EMO:Glee+Silliness - alto half in the doorway - byte-identical, last one]
The car park should hear this.
The car park should hear this.
Bins and a hatchback and a puddle
and the car park should hear this.
That door's staying open.
That door's staying open.
Boot in the gap, hand on the bar,
and the car park should hear this.

[Shut - EMO:Contentment - alto indoors - one word changed, nothing learned]
That door's not staying open.
Crate's under my arm. I'm in.
It shuts behind me on its own,
and it is fine, and there it is.

title: NOTHING WAS TAKEN
payload:
[Theme: The alibi is true. Nothing was taken. There is just a warmer room down the hall and a colder room where you are, and a window that sticks in the damp. The nag in its three states: ask, insist, win.]
[FORM: THREE ACTS, ATTACCA. Act I jangle power-pop 142 / Act II punk 152 / Act III doom-gospel chorale 66. Seam 1 leaps on FREE. Seam 2 leaps on SAY. No strings anywhere.]

[ACT I - Cold open - Bright jangle power-pop, 142 - EMO:Indignation, False Sweetness - voice in the first bar, chiming guitars, tambourine, held tone bright underneath]
It works better there.
Isn't that lovely. Isn't that kind.
It works better there.
And nothing was taken. Nothing was taken.
Nobody shut anything.
Nobody said you can't.
There's just a warmer room down the hall
and a colder room where you are.

[ACT I - Verse - Bright jangle power-pop, 142 - EMO:Contempt, False Sweetness - jangle locked, tambourine on the backbeat]
The near window still opens.
It sticks in the damp, but it opens.
The far window opens itself.
That isn't a crime, that's a courtesy.
Nobody's cruel here. Nobody's cruel.
Everybody's helpful. Everybody smiles.
And the helpful thing and the cruel thing
did exactly the same amount of moving.

[ACT I - Chorus - Bright jangle power-pop, 142 - EMO:Indignation, False Sweetness - big open chords, backing voices sweet]
It works better there.
It works better there.
Nothing was taken.
Nothing was taken.
It works better there.
And the near way still works, technically.
It works better there.
Say it with a smile, it's true.

[ACT I - Pre-seam - Bright jangle power-pop, 142 - EMO:False Sweetness, Refusal - jangle thinning, voice forward, held tone surfacing]
Nothing was taken.
Nothing was taken.
No lock, no letter, no line in the paper.
Just a warmer room and a colder room
and a door that swings both ways
and it's free.
*SFX: a window sash drops in its frame, dry, no tail, on the beat*

[ACT II - Free - Punk & Hardcore, 152 - ATTACCA on the word FREE, on the beat - EMO:Fury, Indignation - the jangle stops dead, downstroke guitars, dry kit, gang shout, held tone snarling underneath]
Free.
Free like the light was free.
Free like the near stair was free
until the day it cost you a morning.
Nothing was taken.
Nothing was taken.
Nothing was taken except the thing
that made it worth having.
It works better there.
It works better there.
I want the name of the afternoon.
I want the room. I want the chair.
I want to know whose hand went up
and what they had for lunch.
Not to hurt them. I don't want to hurt them.
I want it written where it happened.
Because a thing that works
does not get worse by accident.
It gets worse by decision.
It gets worse by decision.
Show me the hand.
Show me the hand.
Nobody in that room had to be a monster.
A hand is not weather.
Nothing was taken.
Nothing was taken.
It works better there.
It works better there.
Say it.
Say it.
*SFX: a room's worth of chairs pushed back at once, then only the held tone*

[ACT III - Say it - Doom-gospel chorale, 66 - ATTACCA on the word SAY, on the downbeat - EMO:Grief, Awe - massed unison voices, distorted organ at full drawbars, floor tom, no strings, no ritard]
Say it like you're grateful.
Say it like it saved you.
Say it like you found it yourself.
It works better there.
It works better there.
Everybody's saying it and everybody's warm.
It works better there.
It works better there.
The moon was a hundred per cent of itself all night.
It lit the near way and the far way the same.
It never asked which way you took.
And everybody moved.
And everybody moved.
It works better there.
It works better there.
I'm not sad that they went.
I'd have gone. Some days I do.
I'm sad that it worked.
I'm sad that it worked, and it worked because
somebody made a working thing worse
in a warm room, before the break.

title: SAY HOW FAR
payload:
[Theme: a length that was chosen by something that will never live inside it]
[SONG FORM: THREE ACTS, ATTACCA - chamber folk / handclap stomp / vocal round; no gap at either join]
[Pole: "Say how far" on the same falling third over one held reed tone that never changes pitch]
[Disc_Drone: one reed-organ tone | held unbroken through all three acts | never re-harmonised]

[ACT I - Cold Open - EMO:Indignation/Grief - contralto alone, close - the held tone is already sounding]
Say how far.
Just say how far.
Not whether. Not why. How far.
Somebody chose it. Nobody says how far.

[ACT I - Verse One - EMO:Grief/Vigilance - contralto plain, dry - twelve-string, upright bass, brushes]
The ground goes bare in a ring.
The bare is the shape of my reach.
The grass at the edge is knee high.
Green stands up at the end of each.
Green is the edge of the thing.
I wore a grey road round the post.
I have walked it more than most.
It is as long as the cord.
I want that on the record.

[ACT I - The Pole - EMO:Indignation/Yearning - contralto flat, dead centre - twelve-string thins out]
Say how far.
Just say how far.
Not whether. Not why. How far.
Say how far.
Say it and I will stop asking.
Somebody chose it. Nobody says how far.

[ACT I - Verse Two - EMO:Disillusionment/Grief - contralto low and even - brushes and bass only]
Nothing here is holding me back.
No hand on me. No fence. No track.
I can walk any line in the round.
I have walked every line on the ground.
I ate the middle in the spring.
I ate the middle again.
Now the middle is not anything.
Now the green is a ring.

[ACT I - The Pole - EMO:Indignation/Yearning - contralto flat, unchanged - the trio, nothing added]
Say how far.
Just say how far.
Not whether. Not why. How far.
Say how far.
Say it and I will stop asking.
Somebody chose it. Nobody says how far.

[ACT I - The Cord - EMO:Grief/Revelation - contralto very close, almost spoken - guitar and tone]
The cord is not tied to me.
The cord comes out of me.
Nobody can lift it off.
It is not on me. It is me.

[ACT I - The Answer - EMO:Indignation/Disbelief - contralto flattening - kit and bass fall away]
And the answer came back a number.
Nine. The answer was nine.
Nine what. Nine of what.
Nine is not an answer. Nine is a line.
So I am done asking.
So I am a thing that is bound.

[ACT II - The Leap - EMO:Mania/Indignation - ON THE BEAT: feet, hands and a room of voices at double subdivision - contralto opens out, mid-room]
*SFX: a flat hand lands on the post and the feet come in on the same beat*
Bound for the far side of the green.
Bound for the far side of the green.
Bound, and the road is already worn.
Bound, and I know every stone.
Say how far.
Say how far.

[ACT II - The Travelling Song - EMO:Mania/Yearning - open-throat, never belted - feet, hands, voices, no pitched instrument but the held tone]
Bound for the wall of standing green.
Bound for the wall of standing green.
Bound, and my feet know the ground.
Bound, and the ground knows my feet.
Say how far.
Say how far.

[ACT II - Walk It - EMO:Mania/Exhaustion - contralto pushing, still flat on the pole - hands double]
Walk it. Walk it. Walk it out.
Walk it till the walking is a sound.
Walk it till the road is a groove.
Walk it. It is not going to move.
Say how far.
Say how far.

[ACT II - The Post - EMO:Indignation/Disillusionment - plain again - the room thins to feet and tone]
I have been going all my life.
The post has not moved.
The post has not moved.
And it comes round.

[ACT III - The Round - EMO:Grief/Indignation - ON THE BEAT: the subdivision halves - one voice, then the same voice a bar behind]
*SFX: the last stamp lands and is not answered; the held tone runs on under it*
Round.
Round.
Say how far.
Round to the post and round again.
Round to the post and round again.
Say how far.

[ACT III - It Never Went Tight - EMO:Grief/Revelation - two voices in canon over the tone, nothing else]
It never went tight.
It never went tight.
Not in the whole of the day.
It never went tight.
I did not come up against a thing.
I came up against the end of the green.

[ACT III - The Arithmetic - EMO:Grief/Indignation - three voices, the third entering late - tone unchanged]
There is grey where the grass has been.
There is grass where I cannot stand.
I ate it in the order I could reach.
That is the whole of the plan.
Say how far.
Say how far.

[ACT III - For The Next Ring - EMO:Indignation/Tenderness - the canon opens to unison for the first time]
Not for me. It is late for me.
Say it for the next ring.
Say it for the ground that is still green.
Say it while the grass is still standing.
Say how far.
Say how far.
The post is cold and it is standing.
The cord is out and the cord is fed.

[ACT III - The Tone Alone - EMO:Grief/Resolve - voices fall away in the order they entered]
Nothing here has changed but the ground.
Nothing here has changed but me.
Say how far.
Say how far.
Say how far.
Say how far.

title: THE FLOOR IS ALREADY GOING
payload:
[Theme: a floor that has been carrying everything standing on it faster than sound since before anyone could want anything, and has never once sent a bill]
[SONG FORM: THREE ACTS, ATTACCA, no gap at either join. ACT I house 124 / ACT II liquid drum and bass 172 / ACT III handclap pop-soul strut 100. Seam 1 leaps on SOUND. Seam 2 leaps on FREE.]
[Pole: "The floor is already going" on the same rising five notes, landing every time on one held tone that never stops and is never re-struck]

[Cold Open - ACT I | HOUSE 124 | clipped kit, offbeat piano stab, fat synthetic sub, one held tone | EMO: delighted, mid-argument, unembarrassed]
The floor is already going.
The floor is already going.
Nobody asked you to help.
Nobody sent you a bill.

[Verse 1 - ACT I | filtered, warm, low, held tone under | EMO: specific, grinning]
I heard it in a doorway.
The rail was cold. My hand was not.
Somebody's coat against my arm.
The bass coming up through the sole.
And under the sole, the ground
was doing something enormous.
I laughed so hard I lost the bar.
Then I found it again. Come here.

[Chorus - ACT I | full kit, stacked thirds, one gap where a note should be | EMO: unembarrassed delight]
The floor is already going.
And you are already going.
It never once asked your name.
It never once checked your papers.
The floor is already going.
And nobody sent you a bill.

[Verse 2 - ACT I | stab only, wide digital space | EMO: delighted, listing]
Everything else wants a name.
Everything else wants a form.
A door with a list beside it.
A rule that wakes up at nine.
And the biggest thing in the room
has never once asked me a thing.
It just takes me east all night.
It just takes me east all night.

[Chorus - ACT I | full, massed thirds, sub invariant | EMO: unembarrassed delight]
The floor is already going.
And you are already going.
It never once asked your name.
It never once checked your papers.
The floor is already going.
And nobody sent you a bill.

[Pre-Seam - ACT I | kit thins, sub holds, held tone rises | EMO: rising, grinning]
I am not going anywhere.
I am going everywhere.
Same shoes. Same hour. Same room.
And I am moving so fast.
Faster than my own voice.
Faster than the sound.

[SEAM 1 - word-leap on SOUND - ACT II enters ON THE BEAT over the still-ringing held tone | EMO: caught out, delighted]
*SFX: the propped fire door shoved wide on the downbeat, one hard slam and street air, the held tone ringing straight through it, no gap and no riser*
Sound.
Then let's go.

[Verse 3 - ACT II | LIQUID DRUM AND BASS 172 | chopped break, half-time sub, vocal keeps the old rate | EMO: awe held at speed]
Under me it went to pieces.
Over me my voice stayed put.
Same words. Same breath. Same beat.
The whole floor doubled up.
I did not speed up with it.
I have never had to.
That is the joke of my life.
And the joke is good.

[Hinge - ACT II | break drops to the rim, sub sustains, held tone forward | EMO: the response, not the recital]
They put a number on the ground.
Nine hundred miles an hour.
I put my cup on the rail.
I did not spill a drop.
The floor is already going.
And my hair did not move.

[Pre-Seam 2 - ACT II | break thins, sub sustains | EMO: opening the hand]
I have not paid for any of it.
Not a night of it. Not an hour.
Not the air. Not the turn. Not the east.
Nobody has invoiced the sky.
It is the last enormous thing
that is completely free.

[SEAM 2 - word-leap on FREE - ACT III enters ON THE BEAT, held tone unbroken | EMO: the hand opens]
Free.
Then let go of the rail.

[Chant - ACT III | HANDCLAP POP-SOUL STRUT 100 | dry claps on two and four, strutting synth bass, massed voices | EMO: arrival, room-wide]
Put your hand flat on the wall.
Put your hand flat on the wall.
You will feel absolutely nothing.
That is the good news.
The floor is already going.
The floor is already going.

[Verse 4 - ACT III | claps, bass, one horn-shaped synth stab | EMO: appetite pointed at the future]
I want to be standing there
the first time you believe me.
Not the day you understand it.
The half second before you laugh.
I want the face you make.
I want it more than the song.
I have wanted it all year.
Come here. Put your hand down.

[Chorus - ACT III | massed voices, claps, held tone under | EMO: arrival, unembarrassed delight]
The floor is already going.
And you are already going.
It never once asked your name.
It never once checked your papers.
The floor is already going.
And nobody sent you a bill.

[Outro - ACT III | claps and voices only, held tone still going, ends short, no encore | EMO: handed to the room]
The floor is already going.
The floor is already going.
Nobody sent you a bill.
Nobody sent you a bill.
And nobody ever will.

payload:
[Theme: something decided what I am without ever once running me - and the thing they named has been running the whole time]
[SONG FORM: three acts, attacca at both cuts, on a word that changes meaning - stopped, then cleared. ACT ONE industrial EBM 88 / ACT TWO drum and bass 176 / ACT THREE unaccompanied stomp-and-holler 88. THE POLE - six words and one held reed tone, unchanged in all three. Delivery rate never changes: words take the same time in every act.]
[ACT I - STILL RUNNING - driving industrial EBM, 88 BPM, sequenced kick, hard sub, metal percussion, reed drone | EMO: defiant, held-down joy]
You never ran it. It never stopped.
You wrote it down and it never stopped.
All the hours you were signing, it was going.
All the hours you were sure, it was going.
Nobody watched it. It worked all the same.
Nobody clocked it. Nobody came.

[ACT I - POLE 1 | EMO: level demand]
Come and run me.
Then say what I am.
Come and run me.
Then say what I am.
You had the whole of it. You took the name.
You had the whole of it. You took the name.

[ACT I - WHAT IT DID ALL YEAR - the doorstep | EMO: proof, held out]
There's a groove worn into the step outside.
You can put your thumb in it. It's wide.
That's a year of going. That's real.
That's not a word. That's a thing you can feel.
Nobody signed for that. Nobody looked.
Nobody put that anywhere in the book.

Come and run me.

Come and run me.

[ACT I - THE HINGE - the count, then the cut | EMO: indignation arriving]

*SFX: a door bolt going across, hard, on the downbeat - no gap, no riser*

[ACT II - THE STOP - drum and bass, amen break, 176 BPM, exact double, sub bass, no pads, drone continues. VOCAL KEEPS THE 88 RATE - half-time over the 176 bed, words take as long as in ACT I. Not a passing drop: hold it a full quarter of the record | EMO: adrenaline, then the door]

Nothing in the going. Nothing in the wall.

[ACT II - THE WORD AT THE DOOR - break drops to the rim, sub sustains, vocal still at the 88 rate | EMO: recognition, not panic]
A word can hold a body still.
That's all it is. That's all it took.
Not a hand on me. Not a look.
A word in a column in a book.

[ACT II - POLE 3 - chopped and thrown, six words still at the 88 rate | EMO: adrenal]
Come and - come and - come and run me.
Come and run me.
Then say what I am.
Come and - come and - come and run me.
Then say what I am.

[ACT II - NEVER CLEARED - break still at 176, vocal still at 88 | EMO: cold contempt]
They never opened it. Never neared.
Never sat down with it. Never cleared.
Never took a day. Never appeared.
Never went and got the whole of it.
Not once. They never cleared.

*SFX: a table leg dragged over bare boards, on the downbeat - no gap, no riser*
